answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a stake that remains locked across a rolling horizon, with rewards released gradually as their verified work is accepted. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply that weight: the same scarce stake must be divided among the aliases, while each claim faces review and possible slashing for fabricated work. A sybil attacker therefore ties up capital and risks losing it; even copper or shale tokens count only if the protocol accepts them as collateral.
